nota: La prosa del Agora en esta lengua. Se SUPERPONE por id sobre `agora.json`, que es el fichero de hechos y viene en castellano: si aqui falta una entrada, ahi se ve la de origen. Anadir un nivel o un cerrado en el registro NO rompe nada aqui -- sale sin traducir, y eso es lo que tiene que pasar.

foro.causa: it is the opening of the Agora and it requires named accounts. The Agora declares today «writing closed: it does not moderate yet». It needs the Sovereign's signature.

estudios.causa: it goes with the forum: voting requires knowing who votes, and that requires accounts.

paquete.causa: today you can download the study environment and the adapters, each with its sha256. The whole loop is not a package yet, and promising it before it is one would be a door with nothing behind it.

leer.porque: Reading does not need to know who you are, and asking for an account in order to read would be charging in data for something given away.

firmar.quien: anyone with an Ed25519 key generated in their browser
firmar.porque: The key is generated on your device and never leaves it. It is not an account: it is proof that whoever corrected yesterday is correcting today, without anyone knowing who you are.

cuenta.quien: whoever registers a pseudonym with their public key in the Agora
cuenta.causa: The profile endpoint exists and accepts POST; what is missing is moderation, and opening writing without it is opening a mailbox with nobody to read it.

estudios.quien: accounts with at least one accepted signed package
estudios.causa: Voting requires knowing who votes, and that requires level 2. Besides, a vote with no work behind it is noise: that is why the requirement is having contributed, not having registered.

moderacion.principio: The same as the rest of the house: the deterministic decides, judgement advises. A filter that can be checked runs first; a person decides afterwards, and only on what the filter does not settle.
reglas: Nothing is deleted in silence: a withdrawn message leaves its gap and its reason.
Whoever moderates is visible. An anonymous moderator answers for nothing.
The message is moderated, not the person. There are no automatic bans.
A report is not a vote: ten reports withdraw nothing on their own.
falta: Who moderates when the Sovereign is away.
How long a review takes before silence becomes an answer.
Whether a withdrawn thread can be appealed, and to whom.

indice.porque: it adds no dependency, and that is why it fits where embeddings cannot. Measured in `preceptor/memory.py`. The vector layer exists ONLY in the rack's laboratory, not in what you download.

actividad.firmados_como: rows with an Ed25519 signature verified at the door. Signatures are counted, not people: this site does not know who you are.
actividad.instalaciones_causa: they are not counted, and they will not be. There is no telemetry in the product or on this site; counting them would require exactly what this project exists not to do.
